title: Why Do Wealth and Attachments Destroy Inner Peace? (1983-01-31)
description:
Do you struggle with attachments to money, food, or family? Discover how balancing your Nabhi Chakra brings true spiritual freedom and inner peace.

This public program explores the Nabhi Chakra (Solar Plexus) and the balance between material wealth and spiritual seeking. Shri Mataji addresses attachments, the spiritual reality behind diet and fasting, and culminates in a guided meditation to experience the Kundalini awakening on your hands.

Key Topics:
• 💛 Understanding the Nabhi Chakra (Solar Plexus) - how the pursuit of wealth, food, and family attachments impacts your spiritual ascent
• 💭 The danger of extremes - why excessive fasting, obsessive dieting, and hoarding wealth damage the subtle system and block true peace
• 🔬 The spiritual root of diseases like leukemia and heart attacks caused by hectic lifestyles and neglecting the left side (Gruha Lakshmi)
• 🌿 The truth about vegetarianism - why listening to your body's energy needs is more spiritual than rigidly following dietary dogmas
• ⚡ Guided self-realization experience - feel the awakening of your Kundalini and verify the cool breeze of the Spirit on your own hands

“Attachment to money, attachment to people, attachment to this, is nothing but a hook which hooks you to baser levels. You have to rise above this, and then you really enjoy the beauty of richness.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• What is the spiritual meaning of the solar plexus chakra?
• How do family attachments affect my spiritual growth?
• What is the spiritual perspective on diet and fasting?

How do you find balance between your material responsibilities and your spiritual seeking? Did you feel the cool breeze during the meditation?
